attributes.name: Shasalqu
attributes.powers:
The Shasalqu is immune to the Cold and Fire traits.

Before you act, each character at your location must succeed at a Wisdom 6 check or recharge 1d4 cards.

If the result of your check to defeat is greater than 15; after you act, each character at your location is dealt 1 Cold damage.
